pr_body:
Fixes #60703. 

Previously, the tests for AST anonymization were restricted to a few
hand-picked statements in
`sql/sem/tree/format_test.go`. Unfortunately, most AST pretty-printing
is instead tested in `sql/parser` so folk have routinely forgotten to
implement anonymization until now.

This patch attempts to fix this by using a datadriven replacement
to `TestParse` that also checks the anonymization code path.

Release note (bug fix): More data from SQL statements is anonymized in
telemetry updates and crash reports.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/60676)

I am planning to extend this PR as follows:

- fold TestParse2 into the same datadriven test
- use multiple datadriven input files, to split the statements into categories
- move the special cases in `tree/format_test.go` into the new parse tests

This makes me wonder if the type signatures could make the compiler help us out here, e.g. if `Expr.Format(FmtCtx)` is always wrong and we should instead be using `FmtCtx.FormatNode(Expr)` maybe we should rename and/or unexport the former? as it is, it seems like a very easy mistake to make.

I also wonder if we should split this up: one PR that _fixes_ all the current mistaken usages and can be backported for existing releases that are leaking unscrubbed crash reports or telemetry and then a follow-up with the capital improvements to prevent it happening again?
yes I agree on this split

issue_context.title: sql: BACKUP option encryption_passphrase does not hide when FmtShowPasswords is not specified
issue_context.body:
Found while investigating #60676

This statement:

```
BACKUP foo TO 'bar' WITH OPTIONS (ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE = 'secret')
```

should render as

```
BACKUP foo TO 'bar' WITH OPTIONS (encryption_passphrase = '*****')
```

unless the FmtShowPassword formatting option is specified

@dt unless this was intended? I can fix in #60676 if desired.
comments: As long as it doesn't render as `secret` in anonymized printing I'm fine with it either way.
ok cool so you can just review the other PR and that will fix it

review_comments:
my guess is this is what is tripping up the schedules code, specifically here: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/ccl/backupccl/create_scheduled_backup.go#L460 

with this change, since that call doesn't pass FmtShowPasswords, it is caught off-guard when tree.AsString doesn't round-trip the AST node back to the the same string
Thanks david, that fixes it indeed.
